{"metadata":{"description":"HUD status panel plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web: git status, MCP servers, skills, model & token usage in a floating panel","id":"gh:1333896990","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-hud","slug":"a903067276-rgb/dsh-hud","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"HUD status panel plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web: git status, MCP servers, skills, model & tok"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"en usage in a floating panel"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-hud 📊"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A **HUD status panel** plugin for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) web: one button in the input toolbar open"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"s a floating panel with git status, MCP servers, skills, official usage info and balance."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"*Unofficial project: independently developed and maintained by a community member, not an official D"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ct: independently developed and maintained by a community member, not an official DeepSeek product.*"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Default form: a **tab in the official right sidebar** (DSH 0.1.5+), toggled by the HUD button left o"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"f the composer —
clicking it again collapses the sidebar. It can also run as a **floating panel** (o"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"lder hosts fall back
automatically) with drag-resizable position and width. The panel shows git stat"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"us, commit history, watched
repos, MCP servers, skills and official usage info (tokens in/out, cache"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" hit rate, per-model breakdown,
context usage)."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Git** — branch, ahead/behind, unstaged / staged / untracked files (collapsible groups),
per-file"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" `+N/-N` summaries, click a file to expand its full diff, last 10 commits
(`commitCount`, 1–50; the "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"commit list starts **collapsed**)
- **Change-driven folding (2026-09-26)** — a clean repo/sub-repo c"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ollapses to a single line
(with ✓ and ↑↓ unpushed counts); a dirty one auto-expands down to the file"},{"id":"p9s5","text":" level. Once you
toggle a repo yourself, your choice wins and is remembered (localStorage)
- **Group"},{"id":"p9s6","text":" folding (2026-10-01)** — sub-repos under the same workspace / watched repo form a
group: when **eve"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"rything is clean only the parent row remains** (with `✓ N repos`), and no
sub-folder names are liste"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"d at all; when something is dirty only the **dirty** sub-repos are
listed and the rest fold into one"},{"id":"p9s9","text":" `▸ N more clean repos` row. Clicking the parent row expands
the whole group
- **Refresh on demand ("},{"id":"p9s10","text":"2026-10-01)** — file changes go through a cheap fingerprint (one shell
call returning each repo's ch"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"ange count / branch / ahead-behind / HEAD): **no full refresh
unless the fingerprint changed**; whil"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"e anything is dirty a full refresh runs at most every
5s so `+/-` details stay fresh. Net effect: a "},{"id":"p9s13","text":"clean workspace costs 1 shell call per change
(previously one shell call per repo)
- **MCP** — conne"},{"id":"p9s14","text":"cted MCP servers (derived from `mcp__<server>__<tool>` tool names)
- **Skills** — skills available t"},{"id":"p9s15","text":"o the current agent
- **Official info** — current model + reasoning effort, plan mode state, token u"},{"id":"p9s16","text":"sage
(input / output / cache-hit rate), session stats (turns, steps, LLM & tool time, decode
tok/s, "},{"id":"p9s17","text":"context usage %)
- **Balance** — official DeepSeek account balance, auto-fetched from
`GET /user/bal"},{"id":"p9s18","text":"ance` using the `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` credential (the key never leaves
the host; shows `--` when unavai"},{"id":"p9s19","text":"lable)
- **Per-model usage** — current session's token buckets broken down by model
(requests, input"},{"id":"p9s20","text":", cache, output), so flash/pro usage both remain visible after
switching"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The button also shows a live badge with the number of uncommitted files, so you can see
at a glance "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"that a project has pending changes without opening the panel."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"This repository is an official **bundle plugin** (`dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client` in the root
`package.j"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"son`), installed through the official profile manager:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Then **restart `dsh web`** (bundle layers are composed at startup; HMR does not apply).
Requires `pn"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"pm` on PATH (`dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm)."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Manual mount fallback: see docs/install.md."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Click the **gauge icon** in the input toolbar (official DSH design tokens, follows
dark/light theme)"},{"id":"p17s2","text":". The panel opens on the left side by default (240px wide), clear of the
official right-edge turn na"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"vigator; **drag its title bar to move it anywhere** (position
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- DSH web >= 0.1.1-rc.1 (run with `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`)
- **Version compatibility** (the per-m"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"odel usage projection uses the DSH 0.1.1+ contract; 0.1.0-rc.7/rc.8 still use the old one):
- ✅ **DS"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"H 0.1.7 and later — use this release (`v1.8.1`)**: it declares `peerDependencies: {"@deepseek-ai/dsh"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"": "^0.1.7-rc.1 || ^0.2.0-rc.1"}`, so a mismatched host refuses to load it with an explicit reason i"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"nstead of failing quietly. Settings move to the 0.1.7 model (plugin `Config`, live-editable `.volati"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"le()` fields), so changes apply without a restart.
- ✅ **DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 — verified compatible**: the"},{"id":"p19s7","text":" peer range now covers both lines (`^0.1.7-rc.1 || ^0.2.0-rc.1`) and `dsh.compatibility.dshReleases`"},{"id":"p19s8","text":" adds `"0.2.0-rc.1": "compatible"` — verified on a real 0.2.0-rc.1 host and a shadow instance. Since"},{"id":"p19s9","text":" 0.2 the host gates profile bundles on peer compatibility and **skips the whole bundle** when the de"},{"id":"p19s10","text":"clared range misses the running host, so this range is what keeps the plugin loading.
- ⚠️ **DSH 0.1"},{"id":"p19s11","text":".5 and older — install the previous tag `v1.4.1`**: that line keeps the old behavior and uses no 0.1"},{"id":"p19s12","text":".7-only API.
- ⛔ **Old plugin releases (up to `v1.4.1`) are not supported on 0.1.7** — every git com"},{"id":"p19s13","text":"mand fails (`shell.run` is gone) so the Git block is empty, and the right-sidebar tab form is never "},{"id":"p19s14","text":"used. Upgrade the plugin together with the host.
- **Maintenance policy**: this plugin keeps evolvin"},{"id":"p19s15","text":"g with the latest DSH releases; compatibility with older DSH versions is best-effort only and not gu"},{"id":"p19s16","text":"aranteed going forward."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Your DSH version | Install this | Note |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| 0.1.1-rc.1 and newer | `main` (v1.2.15+) | Full features |
| 0.1.0-rc.7 – 0.1.0-rc.8 | `v1.2.11` —"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" `dsh plugin add github:a903067276-rgb/dsh-hud#v1.2.11` | Last release with the pre-0.1.1 projection"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" contract |
| 0.1.0-rc.6 and older | `rc6-compat` — `dsh plugin add github:a903067276-rgb/dsh-hud#rc"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"6-compat` | Frozen, no maintenance — upgrade recommended |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- `git` CLI on PATH
- No extra shell needed: DSH's `shell` service executes everything via `bash -c`"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" on all
platforms (Git Bash on Windows), so if DSH runs, this plugin runs."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The host serves JSON over the `webServer` prefix route and runs all git commands in a
**single `bash"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" -c` call** with `__HUD_[BHSLN]__` segment markers (fast project switches).
The client is a hand-wri"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"tten `window.__ModuleLoader__.load(...)` bundle with zero build
step, sharing state between the butt"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"on and the panel through a module-level store
(`useSyncExternalStore`). Details and known pitfalls f"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"or maintainers:
docs/architecture.md."}],"truncated":true}
